in_sanskrit.name: Horil
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Radiant Light
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Horil एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Horil is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Horas' which means radiant light. This name is associated with the goddess Horsha, symbolizing illumination, wisdom, and inner strength. It is believed that a child named Horil will bring light and knowledge to those around them.
